{\n\t\t\t\tlogicalDeadline = turnNumber + len(queue) - i - 1\n\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\twriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, playCampaignTurnResponse{\n\t\tCampaignID:      id,\n\t\tCurrentActor:
